description: Laguna Lake Residences Aster is a lakeside condominium by Laguna Property, the development arm of Banyan Group, inside the Laguna Phuket resort community. It offers 1- to 3-bedroom units of about 56 to 113 sqm, with a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake. The project is a short walk from the Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket dining and retail area.
paymentPlan: 80% installments by construction progress / on completion
facilities: 60 m rooftop infinity pool overlooking the lake

researchNotes: Relationship: Banyan's official URL slug is 'laguna-lakeside-residences' and Keller Henson calls it 'Laguna Lakeside Residences 2'; a July 2025 Banyan release (search summary) calls Aster an extension of the sell-out Laguna Lakeside Residences. It is a separate, newer building, not the earlier Lakeside phase. 'Laguna Lakelands' is a different Banyan listing; no link to Aster found. Official page gives no units, price, completion or ownership; those come from agents and conflict (completion Q3 2026 vs Q4 2027; floors 7 vs 8; prices differ). Brochure PDFs exist (r2.dev, Jul/Dec 2025) but exceeded fetch size, not read. Distances unspecified mode; Banyan nearby labels have no distances. | Papaya: 1BR 11.63M, 2BR 16.81M, 3BR 33.18M (1st-floor units). Keller Henson: 1BR 12.0M, 2BR 18.7M, 3BR 29.1M (FAQ 11.99M-27.67M).
